headerContent.p: An analysis of the Evidlo/xsl-website repository and the art of building websites with zero JavaScript, no build steps, and no server-side code.

section.h2: Welcome to the Future of Simple Web Development
section.p: This site demonstrates the power and elegance of building static websites using only browser-native technologies: XML for content, XSLT for templating, and CSS for styling. No JavaScript frameworks, no build processes, no dependency management—just the web platform as it was designed to work.

div.p: Edit content and see changes instantly. No compilation, no bundling, no watching for file changes.
Handle complex data structures, tables, and hierarchical content with sophisticated XSLT transformations.
Dynamic content rendering based on data attributes and content types, all processed client-side.
Responsive layout with dark/light mode support and contemporary CSS features.
